titles.title: Red Maple (or Fall Leaves)

description: The gray trunk and limbs of a large tree stretch across the canvas. Clusters of red leaves punctuate the tree's mostly bare limbs. Red, yellow, and green trees fill the work's background beneath a bright blue sky.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
